description: Versioned evaluation corpus. expected/<name>.json is hand-audited truth for the fixture in corpus/<name>; known_missing/known_extra record the engine's current deltas so regressions fail and fixes must retire entries. Fixtures with before/ and after/ subdirectories are controlled changes — each state is indexed and compared independently (renames, deletions, removed exports, base-only code). Fixtures with "suite": "usages" are SDK-usage fixtures: `arbor usages . --json` is run on them and compared against expected/<name>.json (usages, clients, captured values, typed gaps, skipped vendored files, and strings that must never be output).

fixtures.name: mono-mixed
fixtures.covers: monorepo layout, vendored dir, generated file

fixtures.name: py-rename
fixtures.covers: file rename keeping symbol and re-attaching the cross-file edge

fixtures.name: py-delete
fixtures.covers: function deleted from a surviving file; stale edge and symbol must vanish

fixtures.name: py-export-removed
fixtures.covers: package re-export removed; stale edge is a recorded precision miss

fixtures.name: ts-crossfile
fixtures.covers: named ES import and cross-file call resolution

fixtures.name: py-real-slice
fixtures.covers: real repository code (pallets/itsdangerous exc+encoding+signer, BSD-3-Clause) with real cross-file calls

fixtures.name: py-sdk-usages
fixtures.covers: OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini SDK usage extraction: aliasing, routing, self.client, constants, v0 API, gaps, vendored dirs, secrets

fixtures.name: py-sdk-real-slice
fixtures.covers: real SDK example code from openai-python (Apache-2.0), anthropic-sdk-python (MIT) and deprecated-generative-ai-python (Apache-2.0)
